title: Tech trends 2026: how phones, laptops, TVs and home appliances have changed
lead: Median specifications of models by release year, from our catalogue of tens of thousands of products. Updated automatically every month — free to quote with a link.

method: Method: we take the median value of each specification for all models in our catalogue released in a given year. Data comes from manufacturers' specifications (Open Icecat and official sources); it is not a sales-weighted market average.
